title: triiiceratops perf-budgets
description: Accepted post-cleanup absolute performance ceilings enforced by scripts/perf/compare.mjs (ticket 25). The comparison job enforces base-vs-head deltas; this file guards absolute drift and fails even when base == head.

acceptedSizeIncreases.description: Reviewed exemptions from the base-vs-head size gate. An artifact listed here may exceed the +5% delta as long as its head size stays at or below `headBytes`. Use only for intentional cost shifts (e.g. work moving from an external dependency into first-party code, which the base measurement never counted). Delete the entry once main carries the new cost, so the ordinary gate resumes.

headBytes.description: Maximum accepted head size in bytes. A head larger than this fails even with the exemption.

runtime.description: Per-scenario median ceilings in milliseconds (captured median with noise headroom).
